title: impl_string_enum: Display and serde use same wire strings — role comparison is safe
description: The MailboxRole::to_string() comparison in handle_mailbox_set role uniqueness check is safe. impl_string_enum\! generates Display and Serialize from the same $s literal, so to_string() == wire format is guaranteed by construction. A contributor suggesting 'just compare the serde output' would add complexity for no benefit.
